Messages.Author: Nu
Messages.Body:
Just three questions:
1) If you use Clotho's Gift TEM effect on Nu, The Pillar, is he able
to untap twice in a given turn?
2) Since The Slaughterhouse is not a unique location, can I play more
than one AND use them all in my master phase?
3) I always get confused when using Mirror Image and Call of the
Hungry Dead. MI says that the action continues as if unblocked and
CotHD says that the block fails. What is the difference?
Thanks.
Nu

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Nu wrote:
>
> Just three questions:
> 1) If you use Clotho's Gift TEM effect on Nu, The Pillar, is he able
> to untap twice in a given turn?

Yes.

> 2) Since The Slaughterhouse is not a unique location, can I play more
> than one AND use them all in my master phase?

Yes.

> 3) I always get confused when using Mirror Image and Call of the
> Hungry Dead. MI says that the action continues as if unblocked and
> CotHD says that the block fails. What is the difference?

MI is a combat card, so it assumes that the block had succeeded.
CotHD is played before the block succeeds.
